Fed and BoC both land on 28 Oct, so plausible adverse marks on CAD and USD duration, USTs, and USD/CAD–CADJPY crosses are large versus official 3.90% SOFR ACT/360 charged on shocked risk capital. Receive-versus-pay holds on the same names are disagreement, not a sized edge. Preservation is to stay flat until post-meeting marks reprice the curves.
